Create an interactive stacked area chart

Source: R/stackedAreaChart.R
stacked_area_chart.Rd

Stacks several time series on top of each other, so you can read both the total and how each component contributes to it. Buttons on the chart switch between stacked values and shares of the total (100%). It shares the interactions of line_chart(): a crosshair tooltip (every layer with its share, and the total), range buttons, a navigator, drag-to-zoom (double-click to reset), labels at the end of each layer and a legend: click an entry to hide a layer, double-click it to keep only that layer; the other layers re-stack.

Usage

stacked_area_chart(
  data,
  x = NULL,
  color_category = NULL,
  curve = "curveLinear",
  stroke = NULL,
  stroke_width = 1,
  x_ticks = NULL,
  y_ticks = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  x_title_font_size = 13,
  y_title = NULL,
  y_title_font_size = 13,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 20,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  opacity = 0.85,
  axis_col = "#333333",
  legend_box_size = NULL,
  legend_text_size = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  position = c("stacked", "percent"),
  controls = TRUE,
  events = NULL,
  bands = NULL,
  h_lines = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  end_labels = NULL,
  tooltip = TRUE,
  navigator = TRUE,
  range_buttons = TRUE,
  zoom = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  value_format = NULL,
  value_prefix = "",
  value_suffix = "",
  date_format = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  subtitle_font_size = 13,
  x_font_size = 11,
  y_font_size = 11,
  grid_col = "#e9e9e9"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, or a ts / mts object.

x

The time variable: a Date, a POSIXct date-time, a "yyyy-mm-dd" character column or a number. Not needed when data is an mts object.

color_category

Optional. The name of a D3 categorical colour scheme (for example "Tableau10", "Set2" or "Accent", see <https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic#categorical>), used when colors is not given. Defaults to the ddplot palette.

curve

The curve type of the layers. Defaults to 'curveLinear'; 'curveMonotoneX' gives smooth layers that never cross. A complete list can be found here <https://github.com/d3/d3-shape#curves>.

stroke

Optional. The colour of the line drawn on top of every layer, for example "white" to separate the layers. Defaults to the colour of each layer.

stroke_width

The width of the line on top of every layer. Defaults to 1.

x_ticks

Optional. The approximate number of x-axis ticks.

y_ticks

Optional. The approximate number of y-axis ticks.

x_title

Optional. The title of the x-axis.

x_title_font_size

The font size of the x-axis title. Defaults to 13.

y_title

Optional. The title of the y-axis, shown above the axis.

y_title_font_size

The font size of the y-axis title. Defaults to 13.

title

Optional. The title of the plot.

title_font_size

The font size of the plot title. Defaults to 20.

font

The font family to consider for the titles. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background color of the SVG. Defaults to "white".

opacity

The opacity of the layers (from 0 to 1). Defaults to 0.85.

axis_col

The color of the axis text, ticks and titles. Defaults to "#333333".

legend_box_size, legend_text_size

Not used; kept for compatibility.

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

y

Optional. The value columns (wide data), or the single value column of long data with group. When NULL, every numeric column other than x is stacked.

group

Optional. For long data, the column whose values name the layers.

colors

Optional. Colours of the layers, an unnamed vector (recycled) or a vector named by layer.

position

"stacked" (default) or "percent" (shares of the total). It can be changed from the chart when controls = TRUE.

controls

Logical. Show the Stacked / 100% buttons. Defaults to TRUE.

events

Optional. Dates to mark with a vertical line: either a vector of dates (names are used as labels) or a data frame whose first column holds the dates and whose second column (optional) holds labels.

bands

Optional. Periods to shade, as a data frame whose first two columns are the start and end dates. An optional third column holds the labels and an optional fourth column the fill colors.

h_lines

Optional. Numeric reference values drawn as horizontal dashed lines (names are used as labels). Only drawn when transform = "none".

legend

Logical. Show the interactive legend (click to hide or show a series, double-click to isolate it). When NULL (default), the legend is shown when there are two series or more.

end_labels

Logical. Label each line at its last visible point. When NULL (default), labels are shown when there are two series or more.

tooltip

Logical. Show the crosshair and the tooltip on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

navigator

Logical. Show the navigator (a miniature of the full series with a brush to select the visible range) under the chart. Defaults to TRUE; it is hidden automatically on very short charts.

range_buttons

Logical. Show range buttons (1M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, All, ...), chosen from the length and frequency of the data. Only used with dates. Defaults to TRUE.

zoom

Logical. Drag horizontally on the chart to zoom into a range; double-click to reset. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Draw the lines in with an animation on first render. Defaults to TRUE.

value_format

Optional. A d3-format string for values in the tooltip (see <https://github.com/d3/d3-format>). Defaults to ",.2~f", or "+.2~%" with transform = "percent".

value_prefix, value_suffix

Optional. Text placed before and after the values on the y axis and in the tooltip, for example "$" or " km".

date_format

Optional. A d3-time-format string for the date in the tooltip (see <https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format>). When NULL (default), it is picked from the frequency of the data (yearly, quarterly, monthly, daily or intraday).

subtitle

Optional. A subtitle shown under the title.

subtitle_font_size

The font size of the subtitle. Defaults to 13.

x_font_size, y_font_size

The font size of the axis tick labels. Defaults to 11.

grid_col

The color of the horizontal grid lines. Defaults to "#e9e9e9".

Value

An interactive SVG stacked area chart.

Details

Series can be given as wide data (by default, every numeric column other than x; or the columns named in y), as long data (one y column and a group column), or as an mts object. Missing values count as zero when stacking, and negative values are stacked below zero.

Examples

data <- data.frame(
  date = c(
    "2000-01-01", "2000-02-01", "2000-03-01", "2000-04-01",
    "2000-05-01", "2000-06-01", "2000-07-01",
    "2000-08-01", "2000-09-01", "2000-10-01"
  ),
  Trade = c(
    2000,1023, 983, 2793, 1821, 1837, 1792, 1853, 791, 739
  ),
  Manufacturing = c(
    734, 694, 739, 736, 685, 621, 708, 685, 667, 693
  ),
  Leisure = c(
    1782, 1779, 1789, 658, 675, 833, 786, 675, 636, 691
  ),
  Agriculture = c(
    655, 587,623, 517, 561, 2545, 636, 584, 559, 2504
  )
)

stacked_area_chart(
  data = data,
  x = "date",
  curve = "curveMonotoneX",
  stroke = "white",
  title = "Employment by sector"
)



# Long data, shown as shares of the total
library(ggplot2) # for the economics_long data set
stacked_area_chart(
  subset(economics_long, variable %in% c("pce", "psavert", "uempmed")),
  x = "date", y = "value", group = "variable",
  position = "percent"
)
